## Drifted claim or surface
Identify the exact implementation behavior, state semantics, machine contract, or current document that is inconsistent.

## Current repository evidence
Cite the current revision and paths. Distinguish current authority from historical snapshots and dated maintenance records.

## Proposed reconciliation
Describe the minimum correction and every dependent surface that must stay synchronized.

## Historical preservation
State which historical artifacts remain immutable point-in-time evidence.

## Evidence boundary
Record verified, inferred, missing, rejected, or not-computed state explicitly.

## Review and rollback
Define non-goals and the smallest rollback.
